Hi Claire — really excited to get Elysia live on Marketplace. Congrats on the signed agreement.

Short answers up front:
- Entitlement CSV: we need one row per subscription with these columns: external_subscription_id, customer_name, product_sku (Redwood SKU), start_date, seats (if seat-based), billing_tier (if applicable), region, passthrough_metadata (optional).
- Entitlement ID: You can send your internal UUIDs as external_subscription_id; we will create a Redwood entitlement_id on ingestion and return it to you for reconciliation.
- Timeline: Once we receive the signed agreement and a completed entitlement CSV, typical activation is 3 business days (validation + AWS fulfillment handshake), faster if we get the CSV in our template and a DocuSign link for the contract.

Next steps I propose:
1) You send the signed agreement (we got it in thread — thanks) and procurement contact.
2) Fill the attached entitlement-mapping-template.csv and return to us.
3) Jordan (cc'd) will run the fulfillment/entitlement validation and share the HubSpot/Marketplace record and activation date.

I attached the mapping template and a short activation checklist — Jordan will own the runbook.

Thanks,
